title: palicourea scandens

This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relief from inflammation, pain, and fever, making it beneficial for the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Palicourea scandens include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects and have been studied for their potential in treating various diseases.
